title: MagiC: Evaluating Multimodal Cognition Toward Grounded Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2507.07297v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models have led to impressive performance in visual question answering and multimodal reasoning. However, it remains unclear whether these models genuinely perform grounded visual reasoning or rely on superficial patterns and dataset biases. In this work, we introduce MagiC, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate grounded multimodal cognition, assessing not only answer accuracy but also the quality of step-by-step reasoning and its alignment with relevant visual evidence. Our benchmark includes approximately 5,500 weakly supervised QA examples generated from strong model outputs and 900 human-curated examples with fine-grained annotations, including answers, rationales, and bounding box groundings. We evaluate 15 vision-language models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters across four dimensions: final answer correctness, reasoning validity, grounding fidelity, and self-correction ability. M

translated_title: MagiC：面向接地视觉推理的多模态认知评估
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型的最新进展使其在视觉问答和多模态推理方面取得了令人瞩目的表现。然而，这些模型究竟是真正进行了基于视觉证据的接地视觉推理，还是仅仅依赖表面模式和数据集偏差，目前仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们提出了MagiC，一个旨在评估接地多模态认知的综合基准，它不仅评估答案的准确性，还评估逐步推理的质量及其与相关视觉证据的对齐程度。我们的基准包含约5,500个由强模型输出生成的弱监督问答样本，以及900个由人工精心整理、带有细粒度标注（包括答案、推理依据和边界框接地信息）的样本。我们在四个维度上评估了15个参数量从7B到70B的视觉语言模型：最终答案正确性、推理有效性、接地忠实度以及自我纠错能力。
tldr: 该论文提出MagiC基准，通过从答案正确性、推理有效性、视觉接地忠实度和自我纠错能力四个维度评估15个视觉语言模型，系统检验这些模型是否真正具备基于视觉证据的接地推理能力，而非依赖表面模式和数据偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MagiC, a comprehensive benchmark that assesses whether vision-language models genuinely perform grounded visual reasoning by evaluating 15 models across four dimensions: answer correctness, reasoning validity, grounding fidelity, and self-correction ability.
